
```{r scrape, echo=FALSE}
my_scrape <- scrape_data(
  src = c(
    "CBS", "ESPN", "FantasyPros", "FantasySharks", "FFToday", "Yahoo", "NFL",
    "RTSports"
    # "Walterfootball" messes with the ADP calculation
    # "FantasyData" is behind a paywall
    # "FleaFlicker" draft data is not available
    # "NumberFire" runs into an unknown error
    # "FantasyFootballNerd" is not implemented
    ),
  pos = c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "K", "DST"),
  season = 2025, # NULL grabs the current season
  week = 8 # NULL grabs the current week
)
```

```{r projections, echo=FALSE}
my_projections <-  projections_table(
  data_result = my_scrape,
  scoring_rules = custom_scoring,
  src_weights = custom_weights,
  vor_baseline = custom_vor_baseline,
  tier_thresholds = custom_tiers,
  avg_type = "weighted"
)
my_projections <- my_projections %>%
  add_ecr() %>%
  add_adp() %>%
  add_uncertainty()
my_projections <- my_projections %>%
  add_player_info()
#my_projections <- my_projections[my_projections$pos_rank < 50, ]
my_projections$exp[my_projections$exp == 50] <- NA
my_projections$exp <- ifelse(
  !is.na(my_projections$exp),
  my_projections$exp + 5,
  my_projections$exp
)
my_projections$position[my_projections$position == "DST"] <- "DEF"
my_projections$name <- paste(my_projections$first_name, my_projections$last_name)
my_projections <- my_projections[order(-my_projections$points_vor),]
my_projections <- my_projections[, c(
  'id', 'name', 'team', 'position', 'age', 'exp',
  'uncertainty', 'points', 'floor', 'ceiling', 'sd_pts', 'dropoff', 'points_vor', 'floor_vor',
  'ceiling_vor', 'rank', 'floor_rank', 'ceiling_rank', 'pos_rank'
)]
```

```{r save, echo=FALSE}
range_write(
  ss = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cF89TiKjO0TypQvO8YFB5BnqpGhqK6eu99g-S2goGCI",
  data = my_projections,
  sheet = "Week 8",
  col_names = TRUE,
  reformat = FALSE
)
```
